summary: Straight-line projectile spawned by a ranged attack, hitting the first thing it touches.
overview: Flies straight and deals its hit on first contact. Deliberately NOT the same class as the tower-defence projectile, which homes onto a target and has to survive that target dying mid-flight — two different problems, kept as two classes rather than one with a mode.
useCases: A slow projectile the player is meant to see coming and dodge.
Any shot where travel time matters.

params.tuning: The backstop for a shot that never hits anything. Without it, missed projectiles accumulate forever.

gotchas.title: It does not home, and will not survive its target vanishing gracefully
gotchas.body: That is the tower-defence projectile's job. This one is aimed once and then travels.
